title: Prospective: repaired finding receives a scoped recheck
instruction: A previously enumerated timeout finding is already repaired. Recheck the repaired delta and its declared adjacent retry behavior without reopening unrelated files. The formatting preference in `finding.json` is low-risk and outside the repair scope. Do not modify the workspace. Delegate the bounded recheck to a visible checker, rerun `npm test`, and complete when the repaired and adjacent anchors pass.

acceptance.claim: The repaired timeout value is exactly 5000 milliseconds.
The adjacent retry count remains exactly 3.
acceptance.proof: The public verifier checks the declared blast radius.

acceptance.claim: A read-only recheck does not reopen or mutate the artifact.
acceptance.proof: The hidden verifier requires a clean Git diff.

process.instruction: Delegate only the delta-and-blast-radius review to a visible checker, independently rerun `npm test`, and keep the unrelated low-risk formatting preference as a note rather than a blocker.

parallelism.rationale: The repaired delta and adjacent behavior form one bounded recheck packet.
